claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked for every item type with decidable equality, in a Finset state machine with the six operations: the other five operations leave the admitted component unchanged in every state (supply_keeps_admitted is the corresponding frame lemma in this model; the Genesis supply_no_op in Inertia.lean was read but is external and not bound or imported here); one step changes the admitted set iff the operation is an Admit of an item not already admitted; for every finite trace the admitted set is the old set united with all admitted items of the trace and it changes iff the trace contains an Admit of a new item; for every token, Readings L (supply t) and F (supply t, admit t) end in different admitted states in the six-operation machine and in the same admitted state in the machine in which Supply also admits (a two-machine comparison, not an iff over a family of machines). By construction of the machine each operation writes its own state field and Retain and Operate are gated on admission, so that only Admit writes the admitted component and that the six operations are pairwise distinguishable are properties of this definition, not findings about a host. INSTANCES (Nat items): at the probe state with item 0 admitted the six operations on item 0 give six pairwise different results; on the trace [admit 0, admit 1, designate 0, designate 1] the Designate-also-retains machine retains both items while the six-operation machine retains none, and the second designation overwrites the first; admitting item 0 twice gives a set of size 1 (the source counter would give 2). Native exhaustive tables: all 22621 traces of length <= 4 over two items from each of four initial admitted sets (admitted state changes iff a new Admit occurs: 11510, 6516, 6516, 0 changing traces; the mismatch column is recomputed by the checker from flags carried through its programme); footprints of the six operations; 15 pair records (min_len = least length of a trace from the empty state after which some item gives different states under the two operations, over the two-item universe and lengths below 4; contexts = number of (trace of length <= 2, item) pairs at which they differ); 7 conflation counter-models with shortest witnesses (a conflation a_includes_b makes operation a first perform b on the same item); and Reading L / F records for the machines in which Supply also admits and in which Admit also supplies.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: That these six operations or state fields match any host, the Genesis Python model or the Genesis event semantics (forms, instances, requirements); that the six operations are distinct beyond writing distinct fields of this machine (Retain and Operate are gated on admission by definition); that conflating operations is the source of the Reading L / Reading F split of Genesis (a causal reading; only the model-level two-machine comparison is checked); more than two items or traces longer than 4 natively (the Lean statements are general, the Lean instances are Nat items); the inert-inscription model of PG-INERT-DIAMOND (cross-referenced, not imported); any physical or interpretive reading.
